A_trait: floral volatile emission and plant-insect interaction traits across dissertation chapters
decision_note: Primary dissertation by Ariela Haber contains plant-insect experiments later represented by pollinator-focused floral-volatile work and herbivore-performance work in Mimulus guttatus. Pollinator and herbivore responses occur in separate chapters/experiments and do not close on one shared plant reproductive endpoint or one matched floral trait geometry; retain as composite P2 evidence.

BioScience review synthesizing pollinator, enemy and resource-cost mechanisms of flower-size/form variation. Valuable conceptual/source-chasing evidence but not an independent primary study for the systematic primary-study count.
